forge_capabilities.title: Capabilities
forge_capabilities.description: Return what this Forge session can do (workspace, Git, secrets, previews, approvals).

forge_observer_workspaces.title: Observer: list workspaces
forge_observer_workspaces.description: Read-only snapshot of live workspace slots, tasks, and branch state. Includes lifecycle/executor_state — state:requested with empty processes is healthy lazy create (use forge_files_read/forge_edit), not a hung provisioner. Repeated identical polls attach stop_polling guidance.

forge_observer_workspace.title: Observer: workspace detail
forge_observer_workspace.description: Read-only observer bundle: processes, merged MCP tool trail, log tail, plus lifecycle guidance. Empty processes/logs while state is requested are expected. Do not poll this tool waiting for requested→ready; that transition happens only after an execution tool starts the executor.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_observer_activity.title: Observer: tool activity
forge_observer_activity.description: Complete read-only trail of MCP tool calls (redacted request/response). Default returns payloads from mcp_tool_calls. Pass payloads:false for counters only; errors_only:true narrows to failures.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_repository_list.title: List repositories
forge_repository_list.description: List GitHub repositories authorized for this account. No container.

forge_task_create.title: Create task
forge_task_create.description: Create a durable task (goal, decisions, non-goals). Call before opening a workspace for coherent work.

repository.description: Authorized GitHub repository to act on.

forge_task_get.title: Get task
forge_task_get.description: Get a task. mode=full (default), summary (compact resume), or resume (task + workspace + git + handoff in one call).

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_task_list.title: List tasks
forge_task_list.description: List recent tasks, optionally filtered by state or query.

forge_task_update.title: Update task
forge_task_update.description: Finish a task (outcome) and/or record a handoff for the next session.

expected_revision.description: Fails if the workspace moved on past this revision.

forge_start.title: Start a branch
forge_start.description: Create forge/<slug> on GitHub from base_ref (default: the repository’s own default branch) — before any workspace exists, no container. Pass the returned branch as ref to forge_workspace_create: it adopts an already-existing forge/ branch instead of cutting a new one, so the branch is on origin from the moment it exists at all. If a live workspace already covers this repository, next_step steers you to reuse it instead of creating another.

base_ref.description: Branch to fork from. Omit to use the repository’s actual default branch, resolved from GitHub rather than assumed to be main.

slug.description: Branch becomes forge/<slug>. Omit for a generated one.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_workspace_create.title: Create workspace
forge_workspace_create.description: Create a lightweight control-plane coding session and return workspace_id + operation_id immediately. No executor is provisioned here; the first shell, install, build, test, dev, preview, or deploy call allocates an ephemeral executor using the requested runtime/bootstrap settings. Refuses a second live workspace for the same repository — reuse owner/repo#branch instead.

repository.description: Authorized GitHub repository to act on.

runtime.description: Executor runtime to allocate lazily on the first execution call.

bootstrap.description: Run bootstrap when the executor is first allocated, not during workspace creation.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_workspace_get.title: Get workspace
forge_workspace_get.description: Compact workspace summary including branch_policy (must be on forge/). Defaults to compact:true for ChatGPT — pass compact:false only when you need the full dump.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_workspace_destroy.title: Destroy workspace
forge_workspace_destroy.description: End the control-plane session and discard any ephemeral executor state. GitHub branches and forge_edit commits are unaffected; command-created files that were not recreated with forge_edit are intentionally lost.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

expected_revision.description: Fails if the workspace moved on past this revision.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_operation_get.title: Get operation
forge_operation_get.description: After a disconnect or unknown tool outcome, check whether operation op_... finished, failed, or is still active.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_files_list.title: List files
forge_files_list.description: List a bounded file tree from the selected GitHub branch. No executor is allocated and no executor filesystem is consulted. Paths come back repo-relative, which is the form forge_edit and forge_files_read take.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

path.description: Repo-relative, or absolute at or under /workspace/repo.

forge_files_read.title: Read files
forge_files_read.description: Read one file or several directly from the selected GitHub branch without allocating an executor. The read guard that protects forge_edit is server-side; no input takes a hash back.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

path.description: Repo-relative, or absolute at or under /workspace/repo.

__schema1.description: Repo-relative, or absolute at or under /workspace/repo.

forge_edit.title: Edit files
forge_edit.description: Edit files. Committed straight to GitHub on your branch — no push, nothing left only in the workspace. Prefer replace: [{old,new}] and send only the fragment you are changing; Forge reads the current file and applies it. Use content for a whole new file, or content:null to delete. Returns the commit URL.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_diff_metadata.title: Diff metadata
forge_diff_metadata.description: Syntax-only metadata over the GitHub branch comparison: changed symbols, secret risk, file classification, and suggested hunks. No executor is allocated.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_context_get.title: Get context
forge_context_get.description: Deterministic repo-context selection for a goal. Returns ranked file paths with reasons, adjacent tests, governing instructions, and confidence scores. Does NOT return file contents — use forge_files_read for that.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_shell.title: Run command
forge_shell.description: Allocate an ephemeral executor on first use and run a command for up to 30 seconds. Set async:true for known-long work; otherwise a long-running command returns process_id. Refused while a dependency install is still running — wait that process first. Never edit repo files via shell (sed/redirects/git add/commit/push) — use forge_edit. Command-created files remain executor-only and report remote_persisted:false.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

cwd.description: Working directory inside the workspace; must start with /workspace.

expected_revision.description: Fails if the workspace moved on past this revision.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_process_list.title: List processes
forge_process_list.description: List managed executor processes. Pass process_id to get one process in detail. Process filesystem effects are ephemeral and never imply a GitHub change.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_process_wait.title: Wait for process
forge_process_wait.description: Observe a managed executor process for at most 30 seconds. timedOut:true is observational: call again with the same process_id instead of restarting it. Process filesystem effects remain executor-only and are never auto-committed to GitHub.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_process_logs.title: Process logs
forge_process_logs.description: Read new log bytes after an opaque cursor. Pass nextCursor until hasMore is false.

forge_process_stop.title: Stop process
forge_process_stop.description: Stop a managed process. force:true cancels harder (SIGTERM then SIGKILL).

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_deps_install.title: Install dependencies
forge_deps_install.description: Allocate the ephemeral executor if needed and start one managed dependency install. Reuse its processId with bounded forge_process_wait calls; do not start a second install. Lockfile changes remain executor-only until explicitly recreated with forge_edit.

forge_pr.title: Pull requests
forge_pr.description: List PRs or read live readiness. Merge and close re-check the head, require human approval, and bind a supplied idempotency_key to one exact mutation.

expected_head_sha.description: Optional concurrency guard from action:status for merge or close.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_access.title: Repository access
forge_access.description: Why Forge can or cannot reach a repository: which repositories this account has authorized, and for one repo whether the GitHub App is installed and what it can do. Call this when a Git operation fails with a permission error, before assuming the transport is broken.

forge_history.title: Commit history
forge_history.description: Recent commits on a branch, or the history of one file. Returns sha, message, author and date — not diffs. Use it to see how a file got to its current state without cloning anything.

forge_branches.title: List or delete branches
forge_branches.description: List branches with proved merge state, or delete one. Live-workspace and default branches are always refused; unmerged deletion needs force plus reason. Large lists report truncation.

expected_sha.description: Optional concurrency guard from action:list. Refuse deletion if the branch tip changed.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key makes a retry safe; omit to always execute.

forge_merge.title: Merge for review
forge_merge.description: Ask the human to merge your work. Opens a pull request from your branch and returns one approval link — echo the link, do not invent URLs. Your branch is already on GitHub; nothing is pushed here. Do not call again while the same submission is pending.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

forge_deploy.title: Deploy
forge_deploy.description: Approved deploy using attached vault secrets. Call forge_secret_list, then pass map_env to rename your keys into what the CLI needs (e.g. { CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: "CF_KEY" }). CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is optional but pins the account when present. Requires idempotency_key; slow runs return process_id, then the same key yields a verified receipt.

workspace.description: workspace_id, "owner/repo#branch", or branch; omit for the sole open workspace.

command.description: Override default command (e.g. npx wrangler deploy).

map_env.description: Process env name → attached vault var name. Example: { "CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN": "CF_KEY" }.

cwd.description: Working directory inside the workspace; must start with /workspace.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key makes a retry safe. Fresh value per distinct call.

forge_review.title: Review URL
forge_review.description: Screenshot a public URL and return images within a 40s capture budget.

forge_preview_expose.title: Expose preview
forge_preview_expose.description: Expose a running process through a short-lived Forge preview URL. Private by default; public access needs approval.

forge_preview.description: Screenshot a workspace app. Omit preview_id to start/expose its server; optional steps drive interactions. Refused while a dependency install is still running — forge_deps_install → forge_process_wait first.

forge_artifact_upload.description: Upload a binary file as a stored artifact. Pass base64-encoded content. Returns artifact id for later retrieval.

forge_secret_list.title: List secrets
forge_secret_list.description: List stored secrets (labels, providers, env var names). Values never returned.

forge_secret_accounts.title: List provider accounts
forge_secret_accounts.description: Use a stored API token to list Cloudflare accounts (id + name only). Pass token_var when the token is not named CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (e.g. CF_KEY). Ask the user which account_id to keep, then forge_secret_update to set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID (env merges; token stays).

token_var.description: Vault env name holding the API token. Defaults to CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, or the sole var on the secret.

forge_secret_create.title: Create secret
forge_secret_create.description: Store env vars as a labeled secret. Encrypted at rest; values never returned.

env.description: Environment variable key-value pairs to store.

forge_secret_update.title: Update secret
forge_secret_update.description: Update label/provider, or patch env vars (merged into existing — so you can add CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID without re-sending the token). Optional unset_env removes keys.

env.description: Environment variable key-value pairs to store.

forge_secret_delete.title: Delete secret

forge_secret_attach.title: Attach or detach secret
forge_secret_attach.description: Attach (default) or detach (attached:false) a secret on a workspace. Attach requires human approval.
